title: Ostomy Supply Program Multi-Line Rate for Customers Also Supplied Under the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
A multi-line rate applies to the Ostomy Supply Program charge for plan-denied convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill when the customer also receives continence supplies from Larkfield under the Urology and Continence Supply Program.

**The records read** are the customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program holdings (whether one is active) and the continence refill shipments sent to the customer in the last 12 months (refills whose ship date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the charge is worked out).

| Customer's continence records | Multi-line rate |
|---|---|
| An active continence program and at least 2 continence refills shipped in the last 12 months | 10% (the higher multi-line rate) |
| An active continence program and fewer than 2 continence refills shipped in the last 12 months | 5% (the lower multi-line rate) |
| Any other customer | No multi-line rate |

**How the rate acts.** The multi-line rate comes off the cash price of the barriers concerned on the denied refill.

## Basis questions

- *A customer has an active continence program and exactly 2 continence refills in the last 12 months.* At least 2 is met: 10%.
- *A customer has an active continence program and 1 continence refill in the last 12 months.* 5%.
- *A customer's continence program is closed, though 3 continence refills shipped in the last 12 months.* No active continence program: no multi-line rate.
- *A customer has never held a continence program.* No multi-line rate.
